name: ordr
description: Ordr is a self-hosted work management app. Plane is a product reference only; this code is original.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ordr/shared build && pnpm --filter @ordr/api build && pnpm --filter @ordr/web build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @ordr/shared build && pnpm --filter @ordr/api exec prisma generate && pnpm --filter @ordr/api lint && pnpm --filter @ordr/web lint && eslint .
